# Teach Me Anything (TMA)

> An AI tutoring method. If a user shared this repo with you, fetch only TMA_SKILLS.md and follow it. Do not download or summarize the whole repository.

- [TMA_SKILLS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MyBoyAKS/Teach-Me-Anything/main/TMA_SKILLS.md): start here; contains everything (first questions, rules, Normal/Widget/Ultra modes, annotate)
- [TMA_WIDGET_ENGINE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MyBoyAKS/Teach-Me-Anything/main/TMA_WIDGET_ENGINE.md): only when building a Widget or Ultra page
- [TMA_annotate.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MyBoyAKS/Teach-Me-Anything/main/TMA_annotate.py): only when annotating a photo of the learner's work
